title: Eventual image of sections of ideal-power quotients on a proper algebraic space
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with unique maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, put $k=A/\mathfrak m$, and let $g:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-trf-algebraic-space, def-sfb-space-morphism-properties]. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed. Let $N$ be a line module on the small etale site of $Z$, meaning a module sheaf locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O_Z$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-trf-algebraic-space]. Put $J=\mathfrak m\mathcal O_Z$, the ideal generated by the images of the elements of $\mathfrak m$ under $g^\sharp$. Products and quotients are sheaf products and cokernels, with $J^0=\mathcal O_Z$; $J^nN$ is the submodule locally generated by products of $n$ sections of $J$ and one of $N$. Cohomology means right derived global sections of the underlying additive sheaf on $Z_{\mathrm{et}}$, and $\Gamma$ means its global sections [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $n\geq1$, let $Q_n=N/J^nN$, let $\rho_n:\Gamma(Z,N)\to\Gamma(Z,Q_n)$ be induced by the quotient, and for $r\geq n$ let $\tau_{r,n}:\Gamma(Z,Q_r)\to\Gamma(Z,Q_n)$ be induced by $J^rN\subseteq J^nN$. For every integer $n\geq1$ there is an integer $c(n)\geq n$ such that for every $r\geq c(n)$,
$$\operatorname{Im}(\tau_{r,n})=\operatorname{Im}(\rho_n).$$
There is no completeness, flatness, schematic-fibre or ampleness hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 08AY (lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal), part (3) at p = 0 and I = m, specialized to a line module; Situation 08AV. Proper over a Noetherian affine base makes Z Noetherian, so the line module is coherent.

proof.text: For every etale scheme chart $U\to Z$, its composite with $g$ is locally of finite type by the chart definition of finite type. Since $\operatorname{Spec}A$ is locally Noetherian, [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] shows that $U$ is locally Noetherian. Thus $Z$ is locally Noetherian in the chart sense. Its structure module is coherent by [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support]. On a cover trivializing the line module $N$ it is the structure module; hence its chart modules are locally finite free of rank one and $N$ is coherent.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: The ideal $\mathfrak m$ has finitely many generators. For each $s\geq1$, their degree-$s$ monomials give a map from a finite direct sum of copies of $N$ to $N$ whose image is exactly $J^sN$. Finite direct sums, kernels and cokernels of coherent modules are coherent by [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian]; taking the cokernel of the kernel exhibits this image as coherent. Consequently $J^sN$ and $Q_s=N/J^sN$ are coherent, hence quasi-coherent. Also $\mathfrak m^s Q_s=0$: the action of every degree-$s$ monomial is zero already as a sheaf map.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: We may compute additive cohomology and its scalar action by module resolutions. Use [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model] to work on the equivalent ringed etale site with terminal object $Z$. An equivalence preserves kernels and cokernels by their universal properties and preserves injectives by transporting the defining lifting problem along its inverse; therefore it transports both the global-sections functor and its injective resolutions. Nonnegative injective module resolutions exist by [lem-sfb-module-resolution-derived-presheaf-comparison]. At the terminal object [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-site-module-abelian-evaluation-comparison] identifies their cohomology naturally with additive sheaf cohomology, identically in degree zero. Applying naturality to multiplication by each $a\in A$ gives the same $A$-action. Global sections with this action is a left exact additive functor to $A$-modules. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] supplies $A$-linear long exact sequences, natural in short exact sequences, for the cohomology in the item.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: Fix $n\geq1$ and set $L_n=H^1(Z,J^nN)$ and $D_n=\Gamma(Z,Q_n)$. The module $L_n$ is finite over $A$: [lem-sfb-space-proper-coherent-higher-images] makes $R^1g_*(J^nN)$ coherent on $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$, and [lem-sfb-space-affine-base-higher-image-sections] identifies $L_n$ with its sections on $T$. Properness gives the quasi-compact and quasi-separated hypotheses of the latter. By the affine-chart characterization of coherence in the former, those sections are $A\otimes_A M\cong M$ for a finitely generated $A$-module $M$. The cohomology convention agrees by step 3. Step 2 also gives $\mathfrak m^nD_n=0$, since the scalar sheaf endomorphisms are zero.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-ideal-power-cohomology-image-bound] with $I=\mathfrak m$, $F=N$, and $q=1$. All its hypotheses hold: $A$ is Noetherian, $g$ is proper, and $N$ is coherent by step 1. Obtain $c\geq0$ such that, for all $m\geq c$, the inclusion-induced map $a_{n+m,n}:H^1(Z,J^{n+m}N)\to L_n$ has image in $\mathfrak m^{m-c}L_n$. The quotients $Q_s$ are not the inputs to this estimate; it concerns cohomology of the submodules $J^sN$.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: For $s\geq1$, the sequence $0\to J^sN\to N\to Q_s\to0$ gives a boundary $\delta_s:D_s\to H^1(Z,J^sN)$, with $\ker\delta_s=\operatorname{Im}\rho_s$. For $r\geq n$, inclusion on the left, identity on $N$, and the quotient map $Q_r\to Q_n$ form a morphism of these short exact sequences. Naturality from [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] gives $\delta_n\tau_{r,n}=a_{r,n}\delta_r$. In particular $\delta_n(\operatorname{Im}\tau_{n+m,n})$ lies in both $\operatorname{Im}\delta_n$ and $\mathfrak m^{m-c}L_n$ for $m\geq c$.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: Put $B_n=\operatorname{Im}\delta_n\subseteq L_n$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-artin-rees] to the finite $A$-module $L_n$, its submodule $B_n$, and the ideal $\mathfrak m$. Obtain $d=d(n)\geq0$ such that $\mathfrak m^tL_n\cap B_n\subseteq\mathfrak m^{t-d}B_n$ whenever $t\geq d$. Linearity of $\delta_n$ gives $\mathfrak m^uB_n=\delta_n(\mathfrak m^uD_n)$: both sides consist of finite sums of $a\delta_n(x)=\delta_n(ax)$. Since $\mathfrak m^nD_n=0$, the intersection is zero as soon as $t\geq d+n$.

source.place: Tag 00IN, lemma-Artin-Rees; the elementary image calculation is also the proof of Tag 00IO, lemma-map-AR.

proof.text: Choose $c(n)=c+d(n)+2n\geq n$. For $r\geq c(n)$ write $m=r-n$. Then $m\geq c+d(n)+n$ and $t=m-c\geq d(n)+n$. Steps 6 and 7 imply $\delta_n\tau_{r,n}=0$, so exactness gives $\operatorname{Im}\tau_{r,n}\subseteq\ker\delta_n=\operatorname{Im}\rho_n$. This uses a bound on the source index $r=n+m$; the displayed sufficient bound on $m$ in the source is therefore converted to a bound on $r$ by adding $n$.

source.place: Tag 08AY, lemma-ML-cohomology-powers-ideal, proof of part (3), specialized to p=0.

proof.text: The quotient maps satisfy $(N\to Q_r\to Q_n)=(N\to Q_n)$. Taking global sections gives $\tau_{r,n}\rho_r=\rho_n$. Hence $\operatorname{Im}\rho_n\subseteq\operatorname{Im}\tau_{r,n}$ for every $r\geq n$. Combining with step 8 proves the equality for all $r\geq c(n)$. None of the steps uses completeness, flatness, a schematic fibre or ampleness.

This is the first delivery: the item is unsplit on live with an empty proof, there is no repair note, and the statement and stmt_deps are unchanged. I read Stacks 08AV, 08AW, 08AX and the full proof of 08AY in spaces-cohomology.tex. The item is 08AY(3) at p=0, I=m, F=N, and its threshold c(n)=c+d+2n correctly converts the source's bound on m into a bound on k=n+m. Step 1: the chart test with V=Spec A plus 01T6 makes Z locally Noetherian, O_Z is coherent by the cited node, and N is coherent because it is locally O_Z. Step 2: J^sN is the image of a monomial map N^k->N, coherent by the kernel/cokernel node, and m^s acts by zero on Q_s. Step 3: the site equivalence, module resolutions, the evaluation comparison at the terminal object (natural, identity in degree 0, so A-linear) and the delta-functor naturality square are each used as stated. Step 4: coherent R^1g_* over Spec A and the qcqs affine-base identification make L_n finite. Steps 5-7: the new node at q=1 bounds the inclusion maps, the delta square has the right direction, and Artin-Rees with linearity gives m^uB_n=delta(m^uD_n)=0 for u>=n. Steps 8 and 9: the arithmetic and the reverse inclusion check out. The new node is exactly 08AX(2): statement-only, self-contained, and true on the cases I tested (affine X, q=0 and q=1, I=0, I=A, m=c). It is not a clause of the item, and grep finds only scheme versions, so it is not a duplicate. Batch-5: the trf definitions, the morphism-properties definition and the two sfb space lemmas reach trf only through algebraic-space foundations. lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model is Stacks 03G0-03G8/03LP foundations, and its 331-node closure contains no trace-formula, Poincare or nt-assume node. All are accepted. The three generic cohomology tool_uses are accepted. No SGA.
